map_info.name: Tutorial_Start
map_info.description: The absolute beginning - just one cube and an exit. Learn to exist in VR space.

documentation.layout: 3x3 entry plate featuring three animated cubes directly in front of the teleporter.
documentation.objective: Demonstrate rotating and oscillating cube behaviors right after spawning.
key_elements: Animated trio: `rotating_cube`, `oscillation_cube`, `rotation_oscillation_cube` across the south row
Teleporter `t` at (1,2) to move into the next tutorial

settings.special_instructions: This is the absolute minimal VR experience - just exist in space and move forward
